linesVerbatim: ## Output projections, including SARIF
**Preserved V1 output-surface contract.** Output surfaces are host-owned
projections over the same canonical result; they do not participate in analysis,
policy, evidence authority, finalization, or D9. For applicable findings/results,
SARIF 2.1.0 remains an optional projection. This does not require every command
to offer SARIF, and SARIF is not OpenSIP's native result or evidence format.
When a command or installed reporting capability advertises SARIF, its serialized
projection preserves the canonical Run and Finding IDs, Coverage, verdict,
truncation state, and artifact references. It uses SARIF-native typed fields where
available and a stable namespaced property contract otherwise. A consumer may
hide extension properties in its display, but that does not permit the serialized
artifact to discard them. Human, JSON, SARIF, and other applicable projections
must describe the same result; rendering success or failure cannot rewrite a
committed Run or change policy, evidence, or its sealed `HostTermination`.
A renderer never chooses public termination or exit; if a required host
serialization/atomic-write operation fails, the host applies the exact D9 output
fault and exit-4 golden described above.
**V2 readiness extension.** DR-122 and DR-G17 require the V1 projection contract
to be carried into the component architecture through a stable host-owned machine
surface, explicit command/capability applicability, schema/version behavior, and
parity/loss conformance goldens. This is readiness evidence for the V2 packaging
and host boundary, not a new semantic authority or a universal SARIF command
requirement.

machineSurface.standing: DECLARED host-owned projection schema. Not a native result or evidence format. Not advertised in preview. Not a packager. Does not mint RunId/Finding recipes.

nativeMappings.opensipValue: artifact location URI when the host already has a URI
nativeMappings.placementRule: For each result r, take hostLocationEntries in listed order. Write the unique primary entry with a locationUri only at run.results[r].locations[0].physicalLocation.artifactLocation.uri. Write each subsequent related entry that has a locationUri at run.results[r].relatedLocations[k] for k=0..n-1 in that same list order. One URI occupies exactly one role per result. Entries without a URI are omitted from native location arrays and remain in opensip.artifactRefs. NFC per written URI.
nativeMappings.normalization: NFC independently per entry before comparison.
nativeMappings.note: Native URI placement does not replace opensip.artifactRefs identity.
nativeMappings.resultIndex: r is the index of the result in run.results[]

hostLocationList.name: hostLocationEntries
hostLocationList.standing: Ordered host list owned by the host canonical result. This contract does not mint artifact-ref recipes.

entry.artifactRef: opaque host artifact identity (DR-006/host owned; not minted here)
entry.locationUri: optional NFC URI when the host already has one

hostLocationList.orderLaw: relatedLocations preserve hostLocationEntries order among entries whose role is related and whose locationUri is present. The primary is excluded by entry identity (artifactRef), not by string-compare of opaque refs to URIs.

cardinality.primary: exactly one entry with role primary and a locationUri when expected.produced is true and native locations are written
cardinality.noPrimaryWhenProduced: refuses native location emission; do not invent a primary
cardinality.related: zero or more; order preserved among related entries that have a locationUri

machineSurface.forbiddenNativeIdentityAlias: run.automationDetails.guid and result.guid are NOT the OpenSIP Run/Finding identity. Using them as if they were mints a recipe this artifact forbids.

runId.standing: opaque value supplied by the DR-006 owner. This contract names the key and type only. It does not mint the recipe. Key OMITTED while DR-006 is INACTIVE.

artifactRefs.standing: opaque artifact identity references supplied by the host result. Cardinality 0..n. Each ref is a string.

verdict.standing: opaque host verdict token. This contract does not mint the vocabulary.

findingId.standing: opaque value supplied by the DR-006 owner. Key OMITTED while DR-006 is INACTIVE.

coverage.standing: opaque Coverage value supplied by DR-006 subjectScopeCommitment owner. This contract names the key only. Key OMITTED while that recipe is INACTIVE.

machineSurface.requiredness: requiredAlways keys MUST be present on every advertised SARIF emission. requiredWhenDr006Active keys MUST be present iff DR-006 recipes are ACTIVE and MUST be omitted (not null) while INACTIVE. requiredWhenHostVerdictExists is present iff the host result has a verdict.
machineSurface.cardinality: One run.properties.opensip object per run. One result.properties.opensip object per result. artifactRefs is an array; other required keys are single values.

unknownAndVersion.additiveUnknownKeys: Unknown keys under properties.opensip MUST be preserved. A consumer UI may hide them; the serialized bytes MUST still carry them.
unknownAndVersion.sameSchemaIdHigherVersion: Additive iff every requiredAlways / requiredWhen* key from this version remains with the same type and meaning.
unknownAndVersion.breaking: Removing, renaming, or reinterpreting a preserved field (schemaId, schemaVersion, runId, findingId, coverage, verdict, truncation, artifactRefs) requires a new projectionSchemaId. It is a failed successor of this schema.

goldenShape.discipline: A golden is a structured JSON object, not a prose sentence. Expected field names are the emitted map names (schemaId, schemaVersion under run.properties.opensip). There is no projectionSchemaId / projectionSchemaVersion key.

input.rule: Exactly one variant governs a golden. The tagged arms are inputNotProduced and inputProduced. There is no untagged legacy input schema and no sibling untagged required hostCanonicalResult object.

not-produced.when: produced=false preview or other not-emitted goldens

produced.when: produced=true; blocked until a real 64-hex DR-006-gated hostCanonicalResult exists

runPropertiesOpensip.note: schemaId/schemaVersion/truncation are requiredAlways. runId is requiredWhenDr006Active (this expected object is the produced/DR-006-active arm). Opaque DR-006 value; not minted here.

findingId.note: requiredWhenDr006Active; opaque DR-006 value; not minted here

coverage.note: requiredWhenDr006Active; rides ID-DEP-S2; not minted here

verdict.note: required when the pinned host result has a verdict; not a DR-006 recipe. Not structurally required on every item.

goldenShape.pass: If produced=false, the adapter MUST emit no SARIF document. If produced=true, parse UTF-8 JSON and compare run.properties.opensip and result[].properties.opensip to expected using the emitted key names. Extra additive unknown keys allowed; missing required keys fail; guid-as-runId fails.

inputNotProduced.forbids: hostCanonicalResult. A not-produced record MUST NOT invent a 64-hex digest. advertisement=sarif is forbidden on this arm for every DR-006 standing. sarif+INACTIVE is invalid-advertisement, not a not-produced reason.
inputNotProduced.reasonBinding: expected.reason MUST equal the expectedReason from inputOutcomeLaw for the selected advertisement/standing. The pass rule still requires produced=false and no SARIF document.

inputProduced.requiresLaw: Only lawful when advertisement=sarif and dr006Standing=ACTIVE and hostCanonicalResult.sha256 is a real 64-hex pin. This arm is unavailable in preview because preview advertisement is NONE.

goldenShape.producedFixturesStanding: No produced=true digest-pinned input exists in preview. Authoring one requires a real 64-hex hostCanonicalResult and is blocked on DR-006 recipe activation (ID-DEP-S1). This artifact does not invent that digest.

inputOutcomeLaw.rule: Authoritative advertisement is preview-none. A golden may not claim advertisement=sarif unless DR-006 is ACTIVE and a real pin exists. requestedProjection is not minted here.
inputOutcomeLaw.invalidAdvertisement: advertisement=sarif AND dr006Standing=INACTIVE is not a lawful not-produced reason. It is an invalid-advertisement negative: preview applicability is NONE, so claiming advertisement=sarif while DR-006 is inactive is a failed golden, not preview-not-advertised and not dr006-inactive.
inputOutcomeLaw.forbidden: variant=not-produced with advertisement=sarif (any standing). The only not-produced lawful advertisement is none.

machineSurface.schemaStability: Additive namespaced properties allowed. Removing or reinterpreting a preserved field is a breaking change and a failed successor.
machineSurface.dr111Join: Whether this machine schema is a DR-111 matrix row is proposed, not self-admitted. DR-111 decides extra rows.
machineSurface.preview: No first-slice command advertises SARIF. This schema is declared so OBL-2 is reviewable; it is not an advertisement.

parityLaw.sameResult: Human, JSON, SARIF, and other applicable projections must describe the same result.
parityLaw.identityRide: Canonical Run/Finding IDs ride DR-006 recipes. This artifact does not mint those recipes. Preview does not claim those IDs are computable.

nonAuthority.verbatim: rendering success or failure cannot rewrite a committed Run or change policy, evidence, or its sealed `HostTermination`. A renderer never chooses public termination or exit
rules: A renderer cannot affect sealed HostTermination.
A renderer cannot choose D9 or exit.

requiredOutputFailure.behavior: Host-finalization-only. A required host serialization/atomic-write failure: if an authoritative Run was already committed, preserve that Run identity and sealed HostTermination; otherwise create no Run identity. The public command ends operational-failed with OUTPUT.SERIALIZATION_FAILED; exit derives from D9 v1.14 classToExitCode (operational-failed -> 4). This is not a renderer-authority refusal.
requiredOutputFailure.ownerOfValues: D9 v1.14 already records this golden. This artifact binds the projection to that golden. It does not mint a new D9 code or a new exit number.
requiredOutputFailure.componentsCannotSelect: Components cannot select the sealed termination or this host output failure.
requiredOutputFailure.committedRunBoundary: Run preservation is conditional on an already-committed authoritative Run. Commands with no committed Run (help/version and any other) do not gain a Run to satisfy this golden.
requiredOutputFailure.notARendererRefusal: Ordinary output failure is distinct from FC-NONAUTH-TERM (D9/HostTermination authority-injection) and FC-NONAUTH-COVERAGE (Coverage/verdict rewrite; INACTIVE on ID-DEP-S2). The host applies the D9 golden; it does not refuse the renderer.

fixtureClasses.requires: A table of first-slice commands vs advertised projections. Preview table: analyze/doctor/help/version advertise human+json only; SARIF column is not-advertised.

When (and only when) a command advertises SARIF, goldens showing Run/Finding IDs, Coverage, verdict, truncation, and artifact references survive serialization. INACTIVE for preview because nothing advertises SARIF.
fixtureClasses.conditionality: Activates if a later DR-006 recipe-close restores analyze advertisement.

fixtureClasses.requires: When (and only when) a command advertises SARIF: a golden where a consumer hides namespaced properties in display but the serialized bytes still carry every required opensip key and every additive unknown key. INACTIVE for preview because nothing advertises SARIF. Same owning ride as FC-PARITY.
fixtureClasses.ride: ID-DEP-S1/DR-006 advertisement restore (same condition as FC-PARITY)

fixtureClasses.requires: Negative tests of renderer authority-injection on D9 and HostTermination only: a renderer-chosen D9 and a rewritten HostTermination refuse. Does not include Coverage preservation. Ordinary required serialization/atomic-write failure is FC-OUTFAIL. These tests do not require SARIF to be advertised.
fixtureClasses.scope: any host-owned projection including JSON; does not require SARIF advertisement
fixtureClasses.rideNote: Active host-projection fixture with no parked dependency for D9/HostTermination negatives.

fixtureClasses.requires: Negative test that a discarded Coverage/verdict cannot be rewritten by a renderer. Requires DR-006 Coverage to be an active host result field.
fixtureClasses.scope: any host-owned projection including JSON; does not require SARIF advertisement
fixtureClasses.rideNote: Coverage-preservation subcase is not preview-active. Activates with ID-DEP-S2.

fixtureClasses.requires: Exact D9 v1.14 machine-output-serialization-failed golden at host-finalization-only scope: if an authoritative Run was already committed, preserve its identity and sealed termination; otherwise no Run identity is created. Public termination is operational-failed with OUTPUT.SERIALIZATION_FAILED; exit derives from classToExitCode (recorded 4). Help/version or any command with no committed Run MUST NOT acquire a fictitious Run/RunId.
fixtureClasses.scope: host-finalization only; any host-owned required projection including JSON
fixtureClasses.rideNote: Active host-projection fixture with no parked dependency. ride:null is the explicit representation, same as FC-APPLIC.

dependencies.consequence: If DR-006 closes by scoped disposition, advertised SARIF drops (already the preview fact). This artifact does not invent the recipes.
Parity goldens that require Coverage identity wait on that recipe.
This artifact cites the existing golden. It mints no code.
